releaseNotes: v1.0.0: First release. Local control of Roborock vacuums: live status, Vacuum Control, room cleaning, fan and mop settings, Roborock scenes (cloud) with a self-updating list, automatic IP recovery, an optional dashboard tile and a Diagnostics report for support. Coming from the beta: Full logging now turns off after 30 minutes.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Roborock Integration
apps.description: Signs in to Roborock once to bring in your vacuums, their local keys and room names, and creates a device for each.

drivers.name: Roborock Vacuum
drivers.description: One vacuum, controlled locally: status, Vacuum Control, room cleaning, fan and mop modes, consumables, scenes and an optional dashboard tile.

drivers.name: Roborock Cloud Helper
drivers.description: Hidden helper, one per account. Only connects to Roborock's cloud to find a vacuum's new IP after it changes.
